title.narrative: UK humanitarian aid to meet urgent needs following the impact of Typhoon Haiyan, Philippines

description.narrative: This activity UK humanitarian aid to meet urgent needs following the impact of Typhoon Haiyan, Philippines is a component of UK humanitarian support for response to Typhoon Haiyan, Philippines reported by FCDO with a funding type of 105 - Humanitarian assistance and a budget of £76,605,450. It works in the following sector(s): Material relief assistance and services.
